measurement_scope: Function/shared setup once per process; each timed pass parses and evaluates the same invocation; startup/setup/warmup excluded from samples
notes: Original eleven workloads; 15 samples and 3 alternating pairs. Guest CPU0 inherited by both workers; Codex/code-mode agents on guest CPUs1-3. No concurrent local builds, tests or profilers. Guest affinity is not physical-host isolation. Candidate const VM separation and fresh function initialization; retain every result, including noise and regressions.

machine.affinity_scope: Runner affinity inherited by both workers; guest CPUs only, not host physical-core placement

limits.note: Same process watchdog for both workers; RSS/HWM sampled on Linux and may overshoot between polls. Boa additionally retains the application sandbox reported by its worker. Temiya has no equivalent cooperative loop/deadline budget.

scope_note: Eleven microbenchmarks only; even a passing comparison does not establish complete application compatibility or superiority on arbitrary JavaScript.
